articles.title: Bitcoin Covenants part 3: SIGHASH_ANYPREVOUT
articles.snippet: APO lets a Bitcoin signature authorize any compatible UTXO rather than one fixed outpoint. It allows for rebindable pre-signed transactions for Lightning, vaults, and layer-2 protocols without new key management overhead.

articles.title: Ripple secures full MiCA license for crypto services across Europe
articles.snippet: The Luxembourg approval completes the company's MiCA licensing process, enabling it to provide regulated crypto-asset services across the European Economic Area.

articles.title: Senator Gillibrand Seeks to Ban Trump, Elected Officials From Launching Meme Coins
articles.snippet: After President Trump disclosed over $1 billion in crypto-related earnings, Senator Kirsten Gillibrand is calling for a meme coin ban.

articles.title: OpenAI Offers US Government a $42 Billion Slice of Itself: Report
articles.snippet: Sam Altman is pitching a 5% equity stake in OpenAI for the U.S. government—and reportedly wants every major AI company to do the same.
